newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU set to return ambassadors to Iran.
newsitem.headline: EU set to return ambassadors to Iran.

text.p: European Union countries are expected to send their ambassadors back to Iran this week, a fortnight after a German court found Tehran involved in the murder of Kurdish opposition leaders.

Diplomats said the decision to return the ambassadors, withdrawn on April 10, would be taken at an EU foreign ministers' meeting in Luxembourg that will also discuss further action to be taken against Iran.
"In this sensitive phase of relations between the EU and Iran it is important to have ambassadors in place," one diplomat said.
"Some (countries) felt that the ambassadors should have gone back earlier, but that was seen as giving the wrong signal," he added.
The 15-nation bloc recalled its ambassadors and suspended its "critical dialogue" policy of trying to bring Iran closer to the West after the German court ruling.
The ministers are expected to consider a proposal on Tuesday to suspend all bilateral visits by ministers to Iran or by Iranian officials in the 15 EU countries.

EU governments would also work together to ensure that visas were not granted to "certain senior members of the Iranian hierarchy" and that Iranian intelligence personnel were excluded from EU member states, implying possible expulsion.
